1. Isaac Murphy Memorial Art Garden is the first
park in the United States to honor the earliest
African American professional athletes – the Thor-
oughbred jockey. The garden is located on land
once owned by Murphy, in the historic East End of
Lexington. The park features art and small outdoor
classroom and is the trail head for the Legacy Trail.
2. Coolavin Park is a great place to park and ride the
Legacy Trail. Restrooms, food and drink are all
located close by and make for a great beginning or

4. Cold Stream Trail Head Located adjacent to Cane
Run Creek this Legacy Trail head offers a porta
potty, a bicycle fix-it station and parking. There are
multiple storm water education viewing areas and
kiosks to learn more about Cane Run Creek and
Lexington’s efforts to keep it clean.
5. Cold Stream Park has a parking area and two
large dog parks.
6. Cold Stream Wet Weather Storage Tank which
helps keep Cane Run Creek free of human waste
has a restroom facility and a water filling station.
